answer.says: Shri Hegde, I take the air. The file will keep until I return; the dust does not.
answer.thought: The air is still too thick for a man of my constitution to linger indoors. I must go to Lodhi Gardens; the tombs stand there as the fixed points of a history that has not yet begun its movement in this place. I need to see the city while it is still quiet, before the heat and the traffic assert their own claim on the day.
